assertion.ray: positive SDF clearance to the first wall, within the 25-map-pixel flashlight range
assertion.pixel_patch: 3x3 pixels sampled at consecutive SDF texels along the selected ray

interpretation: Two independent launches selected different clear rays and produced runs of 21 and 16 consecutive bright patches along those rays. The whole-frame bright-pixel count is diagnostic only; the assertion measures local beam output rather than unrelated map-wide pixels.
